questions.passage: In the end, we found empirical support for Lionel Trilling’s main thesis in his 1950 book The Liberal Imagination: “Literature is the human activity that takes the fullest and most precise account of variousness, possibilities, complexity, and difficulty.” Our studies were correlational, so the causal role of reading literature needs to be tested in the future.
questions.prompt: What limitation accompanies the empirical support for Trilling’s thesis?
options: The studies measured only historical book prices.
No relationship was observed at all.
Reading was experimentally proved to cause all reported differences.
The studies were correlational, leaving causality for future tests.
questions.promptZh: 对 Trilling 论点的实证支持附带什么限制？
optionsZh: 研究只测历史书价。
完全没发现关系。
实验已证明阅读造成全部差异。
研究是相关性的，因果仍需未来检验。
analyses: A 没有书价测量。
B empirical support 不等于没关联。
C correlational 明确排除此处的因果证明。
D 最后一句直接给出限制。哲学文学论点获部分数据支持，也不使其每句话成为实验定律。
